svg.title: JacoPy layer dependencies
svg.text: JacoPy — dependency graph at the layer (package) level
Generated from the code: every .py file under jacopy/ was scanned with ast (2026-10-14, commit 9a11e9b). 186 modules, 70,799 lines, 1,841 unique module→module import edges.
Arrow A → B: "A uses B" (imports it). Rule: arrows point down — like the dependency order from definitions to theorems; a tier uses only what is below it.
closed by the engine on random
downward import, module level (thickness ~ edge count)
sideways edge within a tier (number = module edges)
UPWARD deferred import: the rule's known exception (number = import statements)
central: shared objects/calculus for TM and algebroid E
research: building an engine from a user question
Measured: upward-pointing module-level imports: 0; function-local (deferred) upward imports: 29 statements. A function-local import runs only when that function is called.
Not drawn: central/__init__.py and packages/__init__.py (facade files of 21 and 25 lines); their edges are counted in the measurements but not drawn.
